kira.artwork: Original flashcard stack, pencil, and stopwatch characters with arithmetic marks, number tiles, tally bundles, rulers, and starbursts.
kira.motion: Flashcards lift 5px on intro hover with 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); reduced motion removes this.
kira.scope: Optional interface; Studio remains default and all theme preferences remain independent. Existing Körner sidecar data below is preserved.

scope.compatibility: Semantic colors inherit from the selected theme and resolved light/dark mode. The 59 theme definitions remain independent of interface style. This sidecar documents only Körner Club.
scope.previewContext: Render snippets inside the selected app shell so semantic CSS variables and the shared font resources inherit into the preview shadow DOM.
scope.documentationGap: The incumbent has no root PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md. This scoped extraction does not add a global product identity.
scope.routeExceptions: Auth and verification intros use one column, min-height:auto, no illustration, 45ch paragraph maximum without reserved art space, and clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) title sizing at every viewport. Trainer intros follow existing chrome state; active, finish and AI transition states hide the Trainer intro. Mixed intro appears only without an active or last round.

assets.behavior: Transparent fixed color café scene rendered by Next Image; empty alt inside an aria-hidden wrapper. It does not supply theme colors.
Plus and equals paths are inline currentColor SVG with rounded strokes, aria-hidden ancestor, and focusable=false. Functional arithmetic remains DOM text.

narrative.overview:
Körner Club is a selectable interface variant inspired by KÖRNER food packaging: bold ink, generous paper space, softly curved lettering, and an original café illustration. Its scope is `.app-shell[data-interface-style='korner']`; Studio remains the default and Opaline Abacus remains a separate option.

This document records the implemented variant rather than a global product identity. The arithmetic interface stays task focused: idle trainer introductions carry the illustration, while active and finish states retain the existing focused trainer presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy uppercase Syne introductions paired with italic Newsreader lettering.
Flat surfaces, visible outlines, and moderately rounded controls.
Theme supplied semantic colors in both light and dark display modes.
Decorative raster artwork paired with crisp native math SVG.

rules.name: The Theme Binding Rule
rules.body: Keep color assignments attached to the existing semantic variables so theme and display mode changes remain independent of interface style.

dos: Do scope new Körner treatments to the `korner` interface and reuse the selected theme's semantic color variables.
Do preserve the readable mathematical DOM and the existing focused trainer presentation.
Do keep the original raster scene decorative and native math ornaments responsive to theme ink.
donts: Don't assign a fixed palette to this interface or change Studio's default through this specification.
Don't show the decorative trainer intro during active or finish states where the current presentation hides it.
Don't convert functional arithmetic, control labels, or status feedback into raster artwork.
